Name: Just Monitor Control
Description: A Stream Deck plugin for Windows. It controls monitor brightness, video input, refresh rate, HDR, and sleep.

com.valentderah.just-monitor-control.bri.Name: Brightness
com.valentderah.just-monitor-control.bri.Tooltip: Set an exact level, step it up or down, or switch between two saved states on several monitors at once.

com.valentderah.just-monitor-control.con.Name: Contrast
com.valentderah.just-monitor-control.con.Tooltip: Set an exact contrast level, step it up or down, or switch between two saved levels on several monitors at once.

com.valentderah.just-monitor-control.vol.Name: Monitor Volume
com.valentderah.just-monitor-control.vol.Tooltip: Set, step, or mute the volume of the monitor's own speakers. This is not the Windows volume.

com.valentderah.just-monitor-control.inp.Name: Input Switch
com.valentderah.just-monitor-control.inp.Tooltip: Switch to a specific port, or between two.

com.valentderah.just-monitor-control.ref.Name: Refresh Rate Change
com.valentderah.just-monitor-control.ref.Tooltip: Refresh rates reported by Windows, including exact modes such as 59.94 Hz.

com.valentderah.just-monitor-control.sle.Name: Sleep
com.valentderah.just-monitor-control.sle.Tooltip: Sleep selected monitors or the whole desktop, then wake them again.

com.valentderah.just-monitor-control.raw.Name: Raw VCP
com.valentderah.just-monitor-control.raw.Tooltip: Send a raw DDC/CI VCP code.
